report_name: Android's November Patch Fixes Critical Zero-Click RCE, 'SMS of Death'

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-58868
vulnerabilities.description: A critical, zero-click remote code execution (RCE) vulnerability in the Android Framework that could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on a target device without any user interaction, potentially leading to a full device compromise.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-58882
vulnerabilities.description: A critical denial-of-service vulnerability where an attacker can send a specially crafted SMS message to a vulnerable device, causing it to crash, terminate ongoing calls, or lose cellular connectivity.
